title: A covariate row of appendix Table A3 carries the wrong label
note: The changed artifact is the row label alone; the three means beneath it, 1559.503, 1554.428, 1552.586, are as published and reproduce exactly. The line of the deposited appendix script that produces them is `mean_days = mean(days_on_twitter, na.rm = TRUE)`, and the row label comes from a separate hand-written vector, which says "Number of Tweets" where the equivalent vector for Table A2 says "Days on Twitter". Table A2's corresponding row is labelled correctly, and the two tables print the same quantity on the same scale. Nothing in the article's text or in any other table quotes the mislabelled row.
